Shen Wujiu waited on the other side, his robe still. 'Welcome,' he said quietly.

They hummed beneath my touch, warm as sunlight. Each word was a seed of power, waiting for someone who understood it to make it bloom.

section:1.en: Master Qingwu handed me a worn scroll. 'Begin with the third *section*,' she said. I unrolled it carefully. The words there were simpler, but each one glowed faintly, like a candle behind thin paper. Xiaoxing leaned close and whispered, 'Those words can calm a storm if you say them right.'

I stood before it, heart steady, and spoke one word — the name of the wind that lifts clouds. The tablet cracked softly down the middle, and the path beyond lit up.

mark:0.line: 'Every disciple earns their first *mark* — what matters is which one chooses you back.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu inked a small *mark* on the inside of my wrist before my first test — a character for 'steady,' he said, to quiet nerves.
I entered the examining room and the character burned cold for just a moment, then settled.
sentences.cn: 我走进考场，那个字在我手腕上冷冰冰地烧了一下，然后平复了。

sentences.en: I passed.
sentences.cn: 我通过了。

sentences.en: But when I looked at my wrist afterward, the ink had changed shape.
sentences.cn: 但我之后看手腕时，墨迹已经变了形。

choice:0.en: Two scrolls lay on the table: one red, one grey. Master Qingwu told me the *choice* was mine alone — the red scroll taught words of force, the grey taught words of mending. I held each one. The grey was heavier than it looked. I set the red scroll down and did not regret it, until I heard what was coming up the mountain path.
choice:0.cnHint: 师尊让我在两卷灵文之间自行____，我选了治愈之道，直到听见山路上的动静。
choice:0.hook: Footsteps — too many, and moving too fast.
choice:0.line: 'A *choice* made in peace will be tested in haste — that is how the sect knows it was real.'

sentences.en: Two scrolls lay on the table: one red, one grey.
sentences.cn: 桌上放着两卷纸：一卷红色，一卷灰色。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu told me the *choice* was mine alone — the red scroll taught words of force, the grey taught words of mending.
I held each one.
sentences.cn: 我拿起每一卷。

sentences.en: The grey was heavier than it looked.
sentences.cn: 灰色的比看起来沉。

sentences.en: I set the red scroll down and did not regret it, until I heard what was coming up the mountain path.
sentences.cn: 我放下了红卷，没有后悔——直到我听到从山路上传来的声音。

part:0.en: Xiaoxing told me that memorising words was only one *part* of cultivation — the smaller part, she insisted, tapping her own chest. The larger part lived in the breath and the bone, she said, and could not be read from any page. She demonstrated by speaking a single word that made the ink in my open scroll rise and float. I had memorised that same word an hour ago and felt nothing.
part:0.cnHint: 师妹告诉我，记忆灵字只是修炼的一个____，更大的那部分藏在呼吸与骨骼里。
part:0.hook: She closed my scroll and said, 'Now forget everything you read.'
part:0.line: 'Memory is only one *part* — the word must also trust the voice that carries it.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing told me that memorising words was only one *part* of cultivation — the smaller part, she insisted, tapping her own chest.
The larger part lived in the breath and the bone, she said, and could not be read from any page.
sentences.cn: 修行更大的部分活在气息和骨血里，她说，任何页面都读不出来。

sentences.en: She demonstrated by speaking a single word that made the ink in my open scroll rise and float.
sentences.cn: 她示范着说了一个字，我敞开的卷轴里的墨迹飘起来浮了起来。

sentences.en: I had memorised that same word an hour ago and felt nothing.
sentences.cn: 我一小时前背过那个字，却什么感觉都没有。

bank:1.en: Master Qingwu led us to the edge of the floating mountain, where the great *bank* of ancient words was carved into the stone cliff. Each character glowed faintly, holding centuries of gathered spiritual meaning. 'Study these,' she said, 'before the clouds rise.' I pressed my hand to the cold rock and felt the words breathe.
bank:1.cnHint: 清雾师尊带我们来到石壁前，那里存放着古老词汇的____。
bank:1.hook: One character near the bottom had begun to fade.
bank:1.line: 'This *bank* of words holds every healing formula the sect has ever known.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu led us to the edge of the floating mountain, where the great *bank* of ancient words was carved into the stone cliff.
Each character glowed faintly, holding centuries of gathered spiritual meaning.
sentences.cn: 每个字符都隐隐发光，承载着几百年积累的灵气意蕴。

sentences.en: 'Study these,' she said, 'before the clouds rise.'
sentences.cn: "云升起来之前，去研究这些，"她说。

sentences.en: I pressed my hand to the cold rock and felt the words breathe.
sentences.cn: 我把手按在冰冷的岩石上，感觉到那些字在呼吸。

statement:1.en: At the gate of the Cloud Sea Sect, a senior disciple read aloud a single *statement* carved on a white stone tablet. It named each virtue a true disciple must carry: clarity, patience, and an open mind. The morning mist swallowed his last word before it could reach my ears fully.
statement:1.cnHint: 在门派入口，师兄朗读了石碑上的一段____，列出弟子应有的品德。
statement:1.hook: The stone tablet cracked down the middle without a sound.
statement:1.line: Shen Wujiu said, '*Statement* made — now we see if your actions match it.'

sentences.en: At the gate of the Cloud Sea Sect, a senior disciple read aloud a single *statement* carved on a white stone tablet.
It named each virtue a true disciple must carry: clarity, patience, and an open mind.
sentences.cn: 它列举了一个真正的弟子必须具备的每一种品质：清明、耐心，还有开放的心。

sentences.en: The morning mist swallowed his last word before it could reach my ears fully.
sentences.cn: 晨雾吞没了他最后那个词，在完全传到我耳朵里之前。

identify:1.en: Xiaoxing handed me a bundle of dried spiritual herbs and asked me to *identify* each one by scent alone. I closed my eyes. The sharp bite of wind-root, the sweet hush of cloud-blossom — I named them slowly, one by one. On the last herb I hesitated, and she went very still.
identify:1.cnHint: 师妹让我仅凭气味来____每一株灵草。
identify:1.hook: The final herb had no scent at all.
identify:1.line: 'Can you *identify* this one? No disciple has managed it in three years.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing handed me a bundle of dried spiritual herbs and asked me to *identify* each one by scent alone.
I closed my eyes.
sentences.cn: 我闭上了眼睛。

sentences.en: The sharp bite of wind-root, the sweet hush of cloud-blossom — I named them slowly, one by one.
sentences.cn: 风根的尖锐，云花的温柔——我一个一个地说出了它们的名字。

sentences.en: On the last herb I hesitated, and she went very still.
sentences.cn: 最后一种草药上我犹豫了，她的身体瞬间僵住。

comprehension:1.en: Master Qingwu placed a single line of script before me and waited. My *comprehension* of the old characters was weak, and the meaning slipped like water through my fingers. She did not rush me. Outside, the clouds shifted, and a cold wind moved through the hall without opening any door.
comprehension:1.cnHint: 面对古老文字，我的____十分有限，师尊静静等候。
comprehension:1.hook: The script began to rearrange itself while I watched.
comprehension:1.line: 'Your *comprehension* will grow — but only if you stop trying to force it.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu placed a single line of script before me and waited.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊在我面前放了一行古字，然后等待。

sentences.en: My *comprehension* of the old characters was weak, and the meaning slipped like water through my fingers.
She did not rush me.
sentences.cn: 她没有催我。

sentences.en: Outside, the clouds shifted, and a cold wind moved through the hall without opening any door.
sentences.cn: 窗外的云在变化，一阵冷风穿过大殿，却没有打开任何一扇门。

require:1.en: The entrance trial did not *require* great strength or speed. It asked only that I hold a single word in my mind and speak it aloud with steady breath. Shen Wujiu watched from the arch above, arms folded. I breathed in, breathed out, and spoke. The mountain hummed beneath my feet.
require:1.cnHint: 入门考验并不____力量，只需平静地念出一个字。
require:1.hook: The hum beneath my feet grew louder after I spoke.
require:1.line: 'The sect does not *require* perfection — it requires honesty.'

sentences.en: The entrance trial did not *require* great strength or speed.
It asked only that I hold a single word in my mind and speak it aloud with steady breath.
sentences.cn: 它只要求我把一个字印在心里，用稳定的呼吸把它说出来。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu watched from the arch above, arms folded.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎从上面的拱门处看着，两臂交叉。

sentences.en: I breathed in, breathed out, and spoke.
sentences.cn: 我吸气，呼气，然后开口说了。

sentences.en: The mountain hummed beneath my feet.
sentences.cn: 山在我脚下发出了低鸣。

least:1.en: Of all the new disciples gathered at the outer gate, I had studied for the *least* number of years. The others carried worn scrolls and spoke the old words easily. I carried nothing but a quiet wish. Xiaoxing smiled at me from across the courtyard, as if that were already enough.
least:1.cnHint: 所有新弟子中，我学习的年限____，但师妹的微笑给了我力量。
least:1.hook: A single white crane landed on my empty hands.
least:1.line: 'At *least* you came without fear — that is rarer than you think.'

sentences.en: Of all the new disciples gathered at the outer gate, I had studied for the *least* number of years.
The others carried worn scrolls and spoke the old words easily.
sentences.cn: 其他人都拿着磨损的卷轴，轻松地讲着古语。

sentences.en: I carried nothing but a quiet wish.
sentences.cn: 我什么都没带，只带着一个安静的愿望。

sentences.en: Xiaoxing smiled at me from across the courtyard, as if that were already enough.
sentences.cn: 小杏从院子对面朝我笑，仿佛那已经足够了。

following:1.en: The *following* morning brought thick mist and a message from Master Qingwu pinned to our door. It listed three tasks, each harder than the last: collect dew from the highest peak, copy one hundred characters before noon, and sit in silence until the clouds parted. Shen Wujiu read it twice, then smiled grimly.
following:1.cnHint: ____天清晨，师尊留下字条，列出了三项越来越难的任务。
following:1.hook: The clouds showed no sign of parting by nightfall.
following:1.line: 'The *following* tasks will test what you are made of — rest while you can.'

sentences.en: The *following* morning brought thick mist and a message from Master Qingwu pinned to our door.
It listed three tasks, each harder than the last: collect dew from the highest peak, copy one hundred characters before noon, and sit in silence until the clouds parted.
sentences.cn: 上面列了三个任务，一个比一个难：从最高峰采集露水，在中午前抄写一百个字，然后坐着沉默，直到云散开。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu read it twice, then smiled grimly.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎读了两遍，然后阴沉地笑了。

decide:1.en: At the fork in the mountain path, I had to *decide* alone: the left trail led to the herb gardens, the right to the copy hall where Master Qingwu waited. Both mattered. Both were urgent. The wind pushed equally from both sides, offering no guidance. A single feather drifted down from above.
decide:1.cnHint: 站在山路分叉处，我必须独自____走哪条路。
decide:1.hook: The feather stopped in mid-air and did not fall.
decide:1.line: 'You must *decide* for yourself — the path does not choose its walker.'

sentences.en: At the fork in the mountain path, I had to *decide* alone: the left trail led to the herb gardens, the right to the copy hall where Master Qingwu waited.
Both mattered.
sentences.cn: 两条路都很重要。

sentences.en: Both were urgent.
sentences.cn: 两条路都很急迫。

sentences.en: The wind pushed equally from both sides, offering no guidance.
sentences.cn: 风从两边平均地吹来，没有给出任何指引。

sentences.en: A single feather drifted down from above.
sentences.cn: 一根单独的羽毛从上面飘落下来。

blank:1.en: The stone gate of Cloud Sea Sect rose before me like a frozen wave. An elder pressed a cold jade tablet into my hands. Every disciple's name was carved into it — but where mine should have been, there was only a *blank*, smooth and silent as the clouds below. 'Fill it yourself,' the elder said, and walked away.
blank:1.cnHint: 弟子们的名字都刻在玉牌上，唯独我的位置是一片____。
blank:1.hook: The blank began to glow the moment I touched it.
blank:1.line: 'Your name goes in that *blank* — but only after you prove you have earned it.'

sentences.en: The stone gate of Cloud Sea Sect rose before me like a frozen wave.
sentences.cn: 云海宗的石门在我面前竖起，像一道冻结的浪。

sentences.en: An elder pressed a cold jade tablet into my hands.
sentences.cn: 一位长者把一块冰冷的玉牌塞进了我的手里。

sentences.en: Every disciple's name was carved into it — but where mine should have been, there was only a *blank*, smooth and silent as the clouds below.
'Fill it yourself,' the elder said, and walked away.
sentences.cn: "自己填上，"长者说完就走了。

reading:1.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin scroll on the mountain path, its edges worn soft by a hundred hands. '*Reading* this before the gate opens is the oldest custom of the Sect,' he said quietly. 'The words feed your spirit the way morning mist feeds the stones.' I unrolled it. The characters shimmered.
reading:1.cnHint: 师兄说，进山门前____这卷古籍是门派最古老的习俗。
reading:1.hook: One line near the end had been scratched out — recently.
reading:1.line: '*Reading* it once is enough for most disciples — but you may need it twice.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin scroll on the mountain path, its edges worn soft by a hundred hands. '*Reading* this before the gate opens is the oldest custom of the Sect,' he said quietly.
'The words feed your spirit the way morning mist feeds the stones.'
sentences.cn: "晨雾怎样滋养石头，这些字就怎样滋养你的灵魂。"

sentences.en: I unrolled it.
sentences.cn: 我打开了它。

sentences.en: The characters shimmered.
sentences.cn: 那些字在闪烁。

list:1.en: Master Qingwu stood at the peak and read aloud from a long paper scroll — the entrance *list* of new disciples. Name after name floated out over the clouds like seeds on wind. When she reached mine, she paused. The pause lasted three full breaths. Then she continued.
list:1.cnHint: 师尊宣读新弟子的____时，念到我的名字后停顿了一下。
list:1.hook: No one else seemed to notice the pause but Xiaoxing.
list:1.line: 'Every name on this *list* carries the weight of the mountain — do not forget that.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu stood at the peak and read aloud from a long paper scroll — the entrance *list* of new disciples.
Name after name floated out over the clouds like seeds on wind.
sentences.cn: 一个名字接一个名字从她嘴里飘出来，像风中的种子一样漂过云层。

sentences.en: When she reached mine, she paused.
sentences.cn: 念到我的名字时，她停了一下。

sentences.en: The pause lasted three full breaths.
sentences.cn: 这一停足足停了三个呼吸。

sentences.en: Then she continued.
sentences.cn: 然后她继续往下读。

item:1.en: Before crossing the gate, each disciple laid one personal *item* on the offering stone: a coin, a dried flower, a worn button. These small things formed a quiet line under the sky. I placed my father's old ink brush. The stone hummed beneath it for a moment, as if tasting the memory inside.
item:1.cnHint: 每位弟子要在迎客石上放下一件____，我放了父亲的旧毛笔。
item:1.hook: When I looked back, my brush was the only item still glowing.
item:1.line: 'Choose your *item* with care — the mountain remembers what you give it.'

sentences.en: Before crossing the gate, each disciple laid one personal *item* on the offering stone: a coin, a dried flower, a worn button.
These small things formed a quiet line under the sky.
sentences.cn: 这些小东西在天空下排成了一条安静的线。

sentences.en: I placed my father's old ink brush.
sentences.cn: 我放上了父亲的旧墨笔。

sentences.en: The stone hummed beneath it for a moment, as if tasting the memory inside.
sentences.cn: 石头在它下面嗡鸣了一会儿，仿佛在品尝里面的记忆。

select:1.en: At the gate, Xiaoxing whispered that Master Qingwu did not *select* disciples at random. Every name had been watched for a full year from afar, she said — our words, our silences, even the way we walked in rain. I thought of every careless thing I had ever said, and my chest tightened.
select:1.cnHint: 小星悄悄告诉我，师尊____弟子从来不是随机的，每个人都被暗中观察了整整一年。
select:1.hook: Then Xiaoxing added: 'She almost did not select you.'
select:1.line: 'Master Qingwu did not *select* us for our strength — she selected us for our doubt.'

sentences.en: At the gate, Xiaoxing whispered that Master Qingwu did not *select* disciples at random.
Every name had been watched for a full year from afar, she said — our words, our silences, even the way we walked in rain.
sentences.cn: 每一个名字都被远远地观察了整整一年，她说——我们的言语、我们的沉默，甚至我们在雨中走路的方式。

sentences.en: I thought of every careless thing I had ever said, and my chest tightened.
sentences.cn: 我想起了自己说过的每一句草率的话，胸口紧了起来。

need:1.en: The cloud bridge connecting the outer peak to the inner gate was narrower than my arm-span. Shen Wujiu crossed it without looking down. I stopped halfway. 'You do not *need* courage right now,' he called back, voice steady as carved stone. 'You only need one more step.' I took it.
need:1.cnHint: 站在云桥中央，师兄说我现在____的不是勇气，只是再迈一步。
need:1.hook: The bridge dissolved into mist the instant my foot left it.
need:1.line: 'You *need* to stop looking at the clouds below and start looking at the gate ahead.'

sentences.en: The cloud bridge connecting the outer peak to the inner gate was narrower than my arm-span.
sentences.cn: 连接外峰和内门的云桥比我的臂展还要窄。

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu crossed it without looking down.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎没有低头就走过去了。

sentences.en: I stopped halfway.
sentences.cn: 我停在了中间。

sentences.en: 'You do not *need* courage right now,' he called back, voice steady as carved stone.
'You only need one more step.'
sentences.cn: "只需要再走一步。"

sentences.en: I took it.
sentences.cn: 我走了。

letter:2.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll and pointed to a single mark. 'This *letter*,' she said quietly, 'holds the breath of the wind.' I traced its shape with one finger, and the air around my hand began to stir. Outside, the cloud sea rippled without cause.
letter:2.cnHint: 青悟师尊展开古卷，指着其中一个____，说它藏着风的气息。
letter:2.hook: The clouds below the mountain began to spin in the shape of that very mark.
letter:2.line: 'Each *letter* on this scroll is a living breath — learn it with care.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu unrolled an ancient scroll and pointed to a single mark.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊展开一幅古老的卷轴，指向其中一个单独的印记。

sentences.en: 'This *letter*,' she said quietly, 'holds the breath of the wind.'
I traced its shape with one finger, and the air around my hand began to stir.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指描摹它的形状，手掌周围的空气开始流动起来。

sentences.en: Outside, the cloud sea rippled without cause.
sentences.cn: 窗外，云海在无因地涟漪起伏。

sheet:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin *sheet* of pale bark-paper, covered edge to edge in fine spirit-marks. 'Copy every symbol before dawn,' he said, and left without another word. The marks seemed to glow faintly as the night deepened around me.
sheet:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一____薄薄的树皮纸，上面密密麻麻写满了灵文。
sheet:2.hook: By midnight, one symbol had vanished from the page entirely.
sheet:2.line: 'Guard this *sheet* well — it carries half the healing art of our sect.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a thin *sheet* of pale bark-paper, covered edge to edge in fine spirit-marks.
'Copy every symbol before dawn,' he said, and left without another word.
sentences.cn: "天亮前抄完每一个符号，"沈无咎说道，然后一言不发地离开了。

sentences.en: The marks seemed to glow faintly as the night deepened around me.
sentences.cn: 夜幕深沉，那些符号似乎在发出淡淡的光芒。

corresponding:2.en: Each spirit-herb in the stone garden had a *corresponding* word carved beside it on a small wooden sign. I matched herb to word and felt a soft warmth rise in my palm. Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, saying nothing, only nodding once.
corresponding:2.cnHint: 石园里每株灵草旁都刻着与它____的灵字，我一一配对，掌心生出暖意。
corresponding:2.hook: One sign stood alone — its herb was missing, and the soil around it was cold.
corresponding:2.line: 'Find the *corresponding* herb for each word, and the formula will open to you.'

sentences.en: Each spirit-herb in the stone garden had a *corresponding* word carved beside it on a small wooden sign.
I matched herb to word and felt a soft warmth rise in my palm.
sentences.cn: 我把灵草与对应的字相配，感到一股柔和的温暖从掌心升起。

sentences.en: Master Qingwu watched from the doorway, saying nothing, only nodding once.
sentences.cn: 青梧师尊从门廊看着，什么都没说，只是点了一次头。

choose:2.en: Three scrolls lay before me on the stone table: one the colour of morning mist, one of deep pine, one of amber cloud. 'You may *choose* only one to study this season,' Master Qingwu said. I reached out — then pulled my hand back, uncertain.
choose:2.cnHint: 三卷古籍摆在石桌上，师尊说我只能____其中一卷研习。
choose:2.hook: Whichever scroll I did not choose began to tremble on its own.
choose:2.line: '*Choose* with your breath, not your eyes — the right scroll will feel warm.'

sentences.en: Three scrolls lay before me on the stone table: one the colour of morning mist, one of deep pine, one of amber cloud.
sentences.cn: 三幅卷轴摆在石桌前：一幅晨雾的颜色，一幅深青松的颜色，一幅琥珀云的颜色。

sentences.en: 'You may *choose* only one to study this season,' Master Qingwu said.
I reached out — then pulled my hand back, uncertain.
sentences.cn: 我伸出手——然后又缩了回来，犹豫不决。

single:2.en: Among a hundred spirit-marks painted on the cave wall, Xiaoxing pointed to one. 'This *single* word,' she whispered, 'once lifted an entire mountain.' I looked at its simple strokes and felt something stir deep in my chest, like a bell struck far away.
single:2.cnHint: 洞壁上百个灵字中，师妹指着____一个字，说它曾举起整座山。
single:2.hook: As we turned to leave, that one word on the wall began to shine gold.
single:2.line: 'A *single* true word outweighs a thousand empty ones — remember that.'

sentences.en: Among a hundred spirit-marks painted on the cave wall, Xiaoxing pointed to one.
sentences.cn: 在百道灵符画满的洞壁中，小杏指向其中一个。

sentences.en: 'This *single* word,' she whispered, 'once lifted an entire mountain.'
I looked at its simple strokes and felt something stir deep in my chest, like a bell struck far away.
sentences.cn: 我看着它笔画简洁的字形，感到胸腔深处有什么被触动，像一口远处的钟被敲响。

line:2.en: Master Qingwu drew one slow *line* in the air with her finger, and a faint silver trail hung there like smoke that refused to fade. 'Your spirit follows the path of the stroke,' she said. I tried — my line wobbled, thin and pale, but it held.
line:2.cnHint: 青悟师尊在空中缓缓画出一条____，银色的轨迹悬而不散。
line:2.hook: At the far end of my wavering line, a small cold light began to form.
line:2.line: 'Every *line* you draw in the air is a promise to the sky — make it true.'

sentences.en: Master Qingwu drew one slow *line* in the air with her finger, and a faint silver trail hung there like smoke that refused to fade.
'Your spirit follows the path of the stroke,' she said.
sentences.cn: "你的灵气跟随笔画的路径，"她说。

sentences.en: I tried — my line wobbled, thin and pale, but it held.

sentences.cn: 四个罐子嗡嗡作响，像几条忙碌的溪流，但其中一个罐子里的寂静完全得吓人，似乎还在呼吸。

sentences.en: I chose it.
sentences.cn: 我选了它。

sentences.en: She did not smile — she only looked at the sky.
sentences.cn: 她没有笑——只是抬头看着天空。

comprehension:2.en: Xiaoxing passed me a practice scroll that tested *comprehension* of the five root formulas. I answered three with ease, but the fourth stopped me cold — its meaning hid behind a layer of old phrasing I had never seen. I stared at it so long the ink seemed to shift. A chill rose from the paper without reason.
comprehension:2.cnHint: 小星递给我一份测试五种根本口诀____的练习卷，第四题让我卡住了。
comprehension:2.hook: The ink on the fourth question slowly rearranged itself into a shape I did not recognise.
comprehension:2.line: 'Your *comprehension* of the root formulas is strong, but the fourth one is meant to resist you.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing passed me a practice scroll that tested *comprehension* of the five root formulas.
I answered three with ease, but the fourth stopped me cold — its meaning hid behind a layer of old phrasing I had never seen.
sentences.cn: 我轻松地答出前三题，但第四题让我卡壳了——它的意思藏在一层我从未见过的古老措辞后面。

sentences.en: I stared at it so long the ink seemed to shift.
sentences.cn: 我盯着它看了那么久，墨迹仿佛都在移动。

sentences.en: A chill rose from the paper without reason.
sentences.cn: 一股寒意无缘无故地从纸张里升起。

require:2.en: The welcome rite was nearly over when Master Qingwu raised one hand. 'The final step will *require* each of you to leave one spoken word inside the gate stone,' she said. Shen Wujiu went first, pressing his lips close to the pale rock. When my turn came, the stone was already warmer than it should have been.
require:2.cnHint: 入门仪式尾声，师尊说最后一步____每人在门石中留下一个口述的字。
require:2.hook: The gate stone glowed faintly red where Shen Wujiu's word still lived inside it.
require:2.line: 'The rite will *require* your sincerest word — a hollow one will shatter the stone entirely.'

sentences.en: The welcome rite was nearly over when Master Qingwu raised one hand.
sentences.cn: 迎礼仪式快要结束时，青梧师尊抬起一只手。

sentences.en: 'The final step will *require* each of you to leave one spoken word inside the gate stone,' she said.
Shen Wujiu went first, pressing his lips close to the pale rock.
sentences.cn: 沈无咎最先走上前，把嘴唇贴近那块苍白的石头。

sentences.en: When my turn came, the stone was already warmer than it should have been.
sentences.cn: 轮到我的时候，石头已经比它该有的温度要热了。

least:2.en: Xiaoxing showed me her collection of copied formulas, each page dense with careful writing. 'Learn the *least* powerful one first,' she urged, 'because even a small word, spoken wrong, can unravel stitching in the air around you.' I looked at the simplest formula on the page, and noticed it had already been copied a hundred times — each copy slightly different.
least:2.cnHint: 小星建议我先从____强大的那个口诀开始练习，因为即使小字念错也会有影响。
least:2.hook: The hundred copies of the simplest formula were all written in different hands.
least:2.line: 'Master the *least* powerful word first — even novice errors in it have left scars on this mountain.'

sentences.en: Xiaoxing showed me her collection of copied formulas, each page dense with careful writing.
sentences.cn: 小杏给我看她收集的抄写公式，每一页都密密麻麻地写满了仔细的字迹。

sentences.en: 'Learn the *least* powerful one first,' she urged, 'because even a small word, spoken wrong, can unravel stitching in the air around you.'
I looked at the simplest formula on the page, and noticed it had already been copied a hundred times — each copy slightly different.
sentences.cn: 我看着页面上最简单的公式，注意到它已经被抄过一百次了——每一份抄本都略有不同。

following:2.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a sealed note with the *following* instructions written inside: report to the Echo Terrace before the third bell, bring no scrolls, and speak to no one along the path. I folded it closed, already uneasy. When I looked up, the path to the terrace was empty — but someone had left fresh footprints in the pale dust.
following:2.cnHint: 师兄递给我一张便条，里面写着____的指示：天亮前去回音台，不带卷轴，沿途不得与人交谈。
following:2.hook: The footprints in the dust led to the terrace but did not lead back.
following:2.line: 'The *following* instructions come from Master Qingwu herself, so do not alter a single step.'

sentences.en: Shen Wujiu handed me a sealed note with the *following* instructions written inside: report to the Echo Terrace before the third bell, bring no scrolls, and speak to no one along the path.
I folded it closed, already uneasy.
sentences.cn: 我折好它，心里已经不安起来。

sentences.en: When I looked up, the path to the terrace was empty — but someone had left fresh footprints in the pale dust.
sentences.cn: 我抬起头时，通往露台的路是空的——但有人在淡色的尘埃里留下了新鲜的脚印。

decide:2.en: At the fork between the Herb Path and the Word Tower, I had to *decide* which way to go before the morning bell rang. Xiaoxing had pointed left; Shen Wujiu had pointed right, saying nothing more. I stood still, and the wind pressed at my back from the left — steady, almost deliberate. I chose the Word Tower. The bell rang the moment my foot crossed the step.
decide:2.cnHint: 在草药小路与字塔的岔路口，我必须在晨钟敲响前____走哪条路。
decide:2.hook: The bell's echo lasted twice as long as it ever had before.
decide:2.line: 'You must *decide* your first path alone — the mountain reads the heart behind the choice.'

sentences.en: At the fork between the Herb Path and the Word Tower, I had to *decide* which way to go before the morning bell rang.
Xiaoxing had pointed left; Shen Wujiu had pointed right, saying nothing more.
sentences.cn: 小杏指向左边；沈无咎指向右边，什么都没说。

sentences.en: I stood still, and the wind pressed at my back from the left — steady, almost deliberate.
sentences.cn: 我站着不动，风从左边压在我的背上——稳定，几乎像是故意的。

sentences.en: I chose the Word Tower.
sentences.cn: 我选了言语塔。

sentences.en: The bell rang the moment my foot crossed the step.
sentences.cn: 我的脚踏上台阶的那一刻，钟声响了。
